title: Chọn thế giới thị giác cho OsteoSys
question: Seed đã chỉ định hướng thiết kế số 5. Chọn để tiến hành xây dựng, hoặc chọn phương án thay thế / re-roll.

options.label: Analytical Instrument Panel
options.lineage: DEXA scanner interface / clinical analytical equipment displays
options.thesis: The DEXA scanner's own control panel as the brand: precise measurement channels, dark substrate, one clinical-blue accent carrying every data signal, and the bone-density map as the hero canvas.
options.viewport: Dark near-black ground; full-width bone density scan image occupying two-thirds of the hero viewport. T-score and BMD value displayed as large precision numerals in clinical blue. One sharp white headline: 'Chuẩn xác lâm sàng. Mọi lần đo.' Dual CTA buttons (Explore Equipment / Request B2B Demo) in the lower-left third. No decorative elements — every pixel is measurement.
options.risk: Dark mode may read as technology hardware rather than medical trust in conservative clinical markets; mitigated by pairing with the brand-pinned clinical blues and strict WCAG AA contrast.

raised.raise: Spatial drama: the hero devotes one full viewport panel to a large-format scan image at monumental scale.
Block-grid discipline: product and service cards sit on a strict 12-column grid with controlled gutter rhythm.

options.label: Clinical Report Substrate
options.lineage: Radiology diagnostic report / WHO clinical data sheet
options.thesis: The product seen through the printed radiology report: white substrate, fine rule lines separating data regions, T-score annotation in clinical blue, the scan image as a precision exhibit.
materials: clinical blue accent for data importance
options.viewport: Full-bleed white. Large annotated DEXA scan image left (clinical exhibit style). Right: product name in sharp dark grotesk, one bold BMD value in clinical blue, three validation metrics in fine print rule-separated rows. CTA as a solid clinical-blue block button.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in the medical B2B category land on — familiar and effective, but low differentiation.

options.label: Medical Wayfinding Signage
options.lineage: Hospital corridor signage / AIGA symbol systems
options.thesis: Each section of the portal is a decision junction on a medical corridor: teal sign bands, white humanist type, navigational clarity as the brand grammar.
options.viewport: Nav as a teal sign band across the top. Hero: white corridor background fading to light; one large teal panel center-frame with OsteoSys name and 'Giải pháp đo mật độ xương B2B' in white bold. Teal CTA button.
options.case: Strong audience identification — clinical environments live in this grammar; loses on product clarity because wayfinding reduces OsteoSys to a location, not a precision measurement brand.
options.risk: Can read as hospital signage for a building, not for a product.

options.label: Pharmaceutical Regulatory Dossier
options.case: Fuses poorly: the regulatory dossier world signals submission and compliance bureaucracy, not innovative medical technology purchase — B2B buyers want capability, not paperwork.
options.kept: Clinical evidence hierarchy and tabular data density.

canonCard.label: Chuẩn trang web thiết bị y tế B2B
canonCard.thesis: What every MedTech B2B site ships: product photography on white, structured spec tables, conservative blue accents, ISO badge strip.
canonCard.viewport: White background, product image centered, spec table below, blue CTA.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every competitor in the market.
